'''August 2002 Columbia Heights tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Twin Cities Comics, Columbia Heights, MN on 10 August 2002. [[Rich Jeffery]] won it. It is known from Ivan Gribov's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3915">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-17-ghetto-heights-minnesota-8-10-02d3915/ ghetto-heights-minnesota-8-10-02], DeckTech (Ivan "Executor96" Gribov, 17 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-17-ghetto-heights-minnesota-8-10-02d3915/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 August 2002
* '''Site:''' Twin Cities Comics, Columbia Heights, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Rich Jeffery]]
